terra.problem: “Balaam hired to curse Israel” identifies Pethor in Aram-naharaim as Balaam’s home, but the passage does not say he was hired or attempted to curse Israel there.
“Cushan-rishathaim rules Israel” identifies him as king of Aram-naharaim, but the passage does not place Israel’s subjugation or Othniel’s victory there.
“Ammonites hire help for war” names Aram-naharaim as one source of the hired forces, but the passage does not place the hiring or David’s response there.
